what: Failures fall into two buckets: (1) queries return 0 rows because of exact-match / case / value-format mismatches on string filters and joins (sp0362, sp0536, sp0610); (2) query shape is wrong — returning only names instead of full country records for 'Which countries' (sp0755) or an empty NOT IN due to NULL handling in the Friend subquery (sp0894). The single-shot prompt never inspects actual data values or table columns. I add a schema-guided system prompt that instructs the model to select all columns when the question asks about entities, use LIKE/case-insensitive matching for text filters, and handle NULLs in set-difference logic.

what: Failures persist in two areas: (1) Exact string matching fails when values have case differences or minor whitespace variations (sp0362, sp0536); (2) Subqueries with NOT IN fail silently when NULLs are present, returning empty sets instead of correct results (sp0894). The previous prompt update helped some cases but didn't fully enforce robust handling for these specific edge cases. I will strengthen the system prompt to explicitly mandate case-insensitive LIKE checks for string filters and forbid `NOT IN` subqueries that might return NULLs, requiring `NOT EXISTS` or explicit NULL filtering instead.

Also add a rule to handle NULLs in NOT IN subqueries by suggesting LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL or EXCEPT patterns.
